title: 'Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: If Episode of Mafia' Announces Production Staff
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of hiroja 's Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: If Episode of Mafia ( Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition ) manga revealed the production staff and a key visual (pictured) on Tuesday. The anime series will begin airing on NHK-G at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Phantom Busters' Announces Main Cast, Staff
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shoco 's Phantom Busters manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Pokémon Unite Game Ends Service on March 23, 2027
content: The staff for the Pokémon Unite game announced on Tuesday that the game will end its service on March 23, 2027 for both the Nintendo Switch and mobile device versions. The game has already suspended the sales of the in-game Aeos gem currency, new UNITE Club membership purchases, and automatic membership renewals on…
author: ANN

title: 'Ashita no Joe' Manga Artist Tetsuya Chiba Dies at 87
content: Tetsuya Chiba , best known as the artist for the Ashita no Joe ( Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow ) manga, died on October 27. He was 87. Born in Tokyo in January 1993, Chiba made his professional debut with Fukushuu no Semushi in 1956.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film's Clip Shows Festival Concert
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga began streaming a clip from the film on Tuesday. The clip shows the Ietani family performing a concert at their school's cultural festival.
author: ANN

title: Sora Karin, Kentaro Harada Launch The Pit of Darkness Manga
content: MANGA Plus describes the manga: “The Pit of Darkness”—an empty void that wipes anything thrown into it off the face of the Earth. Kasuga, a boy often taken advantage of by his peers for his diligent nature, happens upon a huge, bottomless pit during a field trip cleaning with his class.
author: ANN

title: Precure Franchise Gets Spinoff TV Anime Dual Shadow ~Precure Villain Heroines~
content: Toei Animation announced on Tuesday that the Precure franchise will receive a television anime spinoff titled Dual Shadow ~Precure Villain Heroines~ that will premiere next year. Unlike most of the previous spinoffs in the franchise , the new anime will feature an original story and characters.
author: ANN

title: Itsuwari no Kenta Manga Ends Next Chapter
content: The December issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine announced on Monday that Yasushi Baba 's Itsuwari no Kenta (The Fake Centaur) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on November 26.
author: ANN

title: 3 New Anime to Watch If You Miss 2000s Anime
content: The 2000s were the era when anime began to enter the mainstream, with several series emerging during this period, including what would eventually become known as the Big Three. It was an era defined by shonen anime, which ultimately shaped its identity.
author: ComicBook

title: Uoyama's Kimi to Issho ni Kayoitai Manga Ends on November 13
content: This year's 21st issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Uoyama 's Kimi to Issho ni Kayoitai ( I Want to Go to School With You ) manga will end in its next chapter on November 13.
author: ANN
